judge.why: The answer distinguishes explicit-header vs. implicit-marker generated files and separately discusses submodule-provided scripts, but never draws the distinction the item asks for — generated-and-committed (checked into the repo, present without any build step) vs. generated-at-build-time (produced fresh by `make`/scripts and not checked in) — nor the differing consequence for an editor (editing a committed generated file requires regenerating and re-committing, vs. a build-time file that's regenerated automatically and never should be edited/committed at all).
